notes.title: Upcoming Game Update 0.8.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Wanted to share we’re actively working on our next update. 
[p align="start"]Here’s a short breakdown of what’s in the works and what you might expect to see.
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
🔁 New Play Types[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We’re continuing to expand your tactical toolbox:
[p align="start"]

QB Draw – Let your mobile quarterbacks shine with designed runs.

Run Option Plays – Adds more offensive flexibility and decision-making.

Better Situational Play Calls – You’ll feel better equipped for specific in-game scenarios (e.g., short yardage, red zone, etc.).
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
🧠 2D Engine Improvements + AI Logic[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We’re tuning the core systems to make every down feel smarter and smoother:
[p align="start"]

Smarter defensive recognition

Improved  play variety from AI teams

Various fixes to animations and player positioning
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
🏆 New Game Mode: "Legends"  - Leaderboard Challenge[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We’re introducing a new competitive franchise mode, where you start with a struggling franchise and get 25 seasons to turn things around:


All GM's will have same set of rules, cap and game difficulty

Once you complete the 25 seasons, your performance will be graded based on various factors and you land on an all-time leaderboard. and see where you compare with the rest of the community!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
💬 Community Requests & Quality-of-Life Fixes[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We’re listening closely, and a bunch of your suggestions are being included, like some additional fixes to award and HOF projections, and various UI and gameplay tweaks based on your feedback.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[hr][/hr][p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Your support means a lot — and your suggestions continue to shape the direction of the game.
[p align="start"]Let us know what you’re most excited about, or what you’d love to see next!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Dev Team
